rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for the active raising and training of a child.

example.english: A child's upbringing takes patience; you can't just scold them.
example.traditional: 教仔真係要有耐性，唔可以淨係鬧佢。
example.jyutping: gaau3 zai2 zan1 hai6 jiu3 jau5 noi6 sing3 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 naau6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this construction when describing that B was brought up by A, especially emphasizing hands-on care until adulthood.

example.english: My mother handled my upbringing and looked after me from childhood to adulthood.
example.traditional: 我由阿媽湊大，細個到大都係佢照顧我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 aa3 maa1 cau3 daai6 sai3 go3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hai6 keoi5 ziu3 gu3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for the manners, values, and other traits someone acquired through childhood upbringing.

example.english: Their good upbringing shows at mealtimes: they never make a racket.
example.traditional: 佢好有教養，食飯嗰陣從來唔會大聲喧嘩。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jau5 gaau3 joeng5 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 cung4 loi4 m4 wui5 daai6 seng1 hyun1 waa1
